latest.raw:
Hi @ChaimaeEH , thanks for reaching out with these thoughtful questions! Happy to clarify:

While the Hackathon is open, you're welcome to keep your repository(ies) private. Repositories must be made public after the Hackathon closes, alongside the CC-BY release of results. Failure to release your repositories upon request or Hackathon closure may result in not being considered for assessment by the judges.

As to what to include in the repository, we ask that you include:
- (required) Documented, reproducible code, including all scripts and configuration files necessary to reproduce your results
- (optional) Submission files for Track 1
- (optional but recommended) Your methods description

Finally, you are free to name the model as neutrally or as specifically as you'd like. We only ask that you include your HF username (or team name) in the filename for tracking purposes.

Thanks again for your interest and participation!
